2608.03743.title: Can LLMs Test Terminal User Interfaces?
2608.03743.paper_summary: Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs) combine the stateful, screen-oriented behaviour of GUIs with terminal deployment and are now common in developer tools. Yet they lack a dedicated testing methodology. We survey 197 real-world TUI applications: only 12% of test code exercises the interface, and 45% of those tests never send input, checking a static frame instead. We turn these applications into a headless benchmark spanning ratatui/Rust, bubbletea/Go, textual/Python, and ink/TypeScript, packaging each as an instrumented Docker image. We record line and widget coverage where reliable, rendered terminal states, and crashes. Under equal wall-clock budgets, we compare four frontier LLMs with random exploration. No model dominates. Random is a strong time-budgeted baseline, but its crash advantage comes from higher throughput: per interaction, LLM guidance is more efficient and uniquely reaches input-gated faults. Automatically deriving launch inputs yields the largest practical gain, enabling applications that otherwise never start. Line coverage poorly predicts crash discovery, weakening it as a proxy for test effectiveness. Automated TUI testing is feasible but far from solved, and honest baselines matter more than model choice. We release the coverage tool tuicov at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuicov and the testing framework tuibot at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuibot.
2608.03743.paper_summary_zh: 終端用戶介面（TUI）結合了圖形用戶介面（GUI）的狀態性、以螢幕為導向的行為與終端部署，並且在開發者工具中變得相當普遍。<lb/>然而，它們缺乏專門的測試方法論。<lb/>我們調查了197個真實世界的TUI應用程式：只有12%的測試代碼實際上運用了介面，而這些測試中有45%從未發送輸入，而是檢查靜態框架。<lb/>我們將這些應用程式轉換為一個無頭基準，涵蓋ratatui/Rust、bubbletea/Go、textual/Python和ink/TypeScript，並將每個包裝為一個帶有儀器的Docker映像。<lb/>我們記錄了可靠的行和小部件覆蓋率、渲染的終端狀態和崩潰情況。<lb/>在相等的實時計算預算下，我們比較了四個前沿的LLM與隨機探索。<lb/>沒有一個模型佔據主導地位。<lb/>隨機是一個強大的時間預算基準，但其崩潰優勢來自於更高的吞吐量：每次互動，LLM的指導更有效，並且獨特地達到了輸入門檻的故障。<lb/>自動導出啟動輸入帶來了最大的實際收益，使得那些本來無法啟動的應用程式得以運行。<lb/>行覆蓋率對於崩潰發現的預測效果不佳，削弱了其作為測試有效性的代理。<lb/>自動化的TUI測試是可行的，但距離解決還很遙遠，誠實的基準比模型選擇更為重要。<lb/>我們在 https://github.com/tui-testing/tuicov 發布了覆蓋工具tuicov，在 https://github.com/tui-testing/tuibot 發布了測試框架tuibot。
